xmldoc.short_description: Launch the nflow editor, optionally on a model file.

param_input_item.param_description: a character vector: the path to a .nflow model file to open in the editor. When omitted, the editor opens on an empty model.

param_output_item.param_description: a handle to the editor window that was opened.

description.p: nflow opens the nflow editor, a browser-based diagram editor for building and simulating models. Called with no argument it opens on an empty model; called with a .nflow file it opens that model.
nflow is the low-level launcher. For opening a model already loaded in memory (by name or handle), or an .ssp archive, use open_system, which resolves those inputs and then opens the editor.
The editor works on the model it was opened with; script-side mutations made while the window is open are not streamed live to it.

example_item.example_item_description: Open an empty editor, then a model file
